channel.title: AYiN Advisors Blog
channel.description: Plain answers to what buyers ask about entering the US through partners, putting AI to work in a small team, and being found online.

item.title: What does a reseller need from a new vendor before they will sell it?
item.dc:creator: Taz Abbas
item.description: A reason their customers will want it, economics that work, protection for the deals they find and a vendor that is easy to work with. A good product alone is not enough.

item.title: Why isn't my new website showing up on Google?
item.dc:creator: Taz Abbas
item.description: Usually because Google has not found it, has found it but not crawled it, or has not yet chosen to show it. Here is how to tell which, and what to fix.

item.title: How do you find and vet a US distributor?
item.dc:creator: Taz Abbas
item.description: Start from your buyers and the products yours sit next to, then vet on fit, specific commitments and real references rather than size.

item.title: Build or buy: when does a custom application make sense?
item.dc:creator: Taz Abbas
item.description: Buy when your process is standard and a product fits most of it. Build when the way you work sets you apart or the tools force daily workarounds.

item.title: What should a US distribution agreement cover before you sign?
item.dc:creator: Taz Abbas
item.description: Scope, exclusivity, commitments on both sides, pricing and payment, brand ownership, warranties and, above all, how the arrangement ends.

item.title: How does a business get mentioned in ChatGPT and Google's AI answers?
item.dc:creator: Taz Abbas
item.description: Let the right crawlers in, publish clear answers to real questions, keep your details consistent and earn mentions elsewhere. No file or markup guarantees a citation.

item.title: How do you build a partner onboarding program that leads to a first deal?
item.dc:creator: Taz Abbas
item.description: Design it backwards from the first sale: teach only what that sale needs, agree on target accounts, hand over ready-to-use materials and sell the first deals together.

item.title: What drives the cost of a custom AI tool?
item.dc:creator: Taz Abbas
item.description: Less the AI itself than everything around it: how clear the problem is, the state of your data, the systems it connects to and how accurate it must be.

item.title: What does a US market entry study include, and is it worth it?
item.dc:creator: Taz Abbas
item.description: Demand, buyers, competition, regulation, routes to market and a clear recommendation. Worth it when the decision is large and the US market is unfamiliar.

item.title: Distributor, reseller or agent: which US route to market fits your product?
item.dc:creator: Taz Abbas
item.description: Each one carries a different share of the stock, the risk and the customer. The right choice depends on how American buyers expect to buy in your category.

item.title: Where should a small team start with workflow automation?
item.dc:creator: Taz Abbas
item.description: Start with one task your team repeats often, that follows clear rules and that does little harm when it goes wrong. Map it, automate the predictable steps and keep a person on the decisions.
